title: Invertibility of strict-henselization cohomology comparison
statement: For a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism f, geometric point xbar, abelian etale sheaf F and q : ℕ, the canonical strict-henselization cohomology comparison is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Combine exact inverse-image/homology, strict-local base-change global homology, strict-local Leray, and the degree-zero single-complex comparison; each is an isomorphism and their composite is the canonical comparison.

lean.statement: theorem isIso_strictHenselizationCohomologyComparison {X S : Scheme.{w}} (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] {Ω : Type w} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (xbar : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S) (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{w + 1}) (q : ℕ) : IsIso (strictHenselizationCohomologyComparison xbar f F q)
